name: ffprobe-browser
description: ffprobe-like for browser and node, powered by WebAssembly
author: FFmpegLab <info@ffmpeglab.com>

scripts.build: npm run tsc && npm run vite
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && start-server-and-test 'vite preview --port 4173' http://localhost:4173/cypress.html 'npm run cy:run'
scripts.test:e2e:open: npm run build && start-server-and-test 'vite preview --port 4173' http://localhost:4173/cypress.html 'npm run cy:open'
